# Nick Smith

Personal site of Nick Smith, a software developer. The working site is https://www.clickthisnick.com.

## How to use the site

- Home (/) introduces four ways Nick can help: release engineering, vulnerability testing, development, and knowledge transfer.
- Blog (/blog/) lists posts. Each post has a "Read More" link and a "Back To Blog" link.
- Projects (/projects/) shows project names, screenshots, and short descriptions.
- Contact (/contact/) shows the email address admin@clickthisnick.com.
- Recruiter intake (/recruiters/) is a form. Fill every required field and press Submit. The page announces that it is sending, posts the answers, then opens the follow-up page with a resume download and a Calendly link.
- Feed: /feed.xml
- Missing pages use /404.html, which links back home.

The header has Home, Blog, Projects, and Contact. The current page is marked in the navigation. The footer has email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Stack Overflow, and RSS, each with a text name.

## Domain

Use https://www.clickthisnick.com. https://clickthisnick.com fails TLS because the apex DNS still points at retired GitHub Pages addresses, and the certificate only covers www.clickthisnick.com. The repository CNAME stays on www.
